fieldContext.note: Replaces absolute 'good requirement' criteria with a progressive lifecycle: 1. Observed Need, 2. Stated Req, 3. Analyzed Candidate, 4. Accepted Obligation, 5. Operationalized AC, 6. Verified Implementation, 7. Monitored Runtime Obligation.

personalNotes: Requirements maturity allows exploratory candidates to coexist with contractually binding items without pretending they possess the same evidence or precision.
